versos.hebraico: נַחֲמ֥וּ נַחֲמ֖וּ עַמִּ֑י יֹאמַ֖ר אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: “Comfort, comfort my people,” says your God.
controles.kjv: Comfort ye, comfort ye my people, saith your God.
controles.livre: Consolai, consolai a meu povo, diz vosso Deus.

versos.hebraico: דַּבְּר֞וּ עַל־לֵ֤ב יְרֽוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ וְקִרְא֣וּ אֵלֶ֔יהָ כִּ֤י מָֽלְאָה֙ צְבָאָ֔הּ כִּ֥י נִרְצָ֖ה עֲוֺנָ֑הּ כִּ֤י לָקְחָה֙ מִיַּ֣ד יְהוָ֔ה כִּפְלַ֖יִם בְּכָל־חַטֹּאתֶֽיהָ׃ס

controles.web: “Speak comfortably to Jerusalem; and call out to her that her warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity is pardoned, that she has received of Yahweh’s hand double for all her sins.”
controles.kjv: Speak ye comfortably to Jerusalem, and cry unto her, that her warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity is pardoned: for she hath received of the Lord’s hand double for all her sins.
controles.livre: Falai ao coração de Jerusalém, e proclamai a ela, que seu esforço de guerra está terminado, que sua perversidade está perdoada; porque já recebeu punição em dobro da mão do SENHOR por todo os seus pecados.

versos.hebraico: ק֣וֹל קוֹרֵ֔א בַּמִּדְבָּ֕ר פַּנּ֖וּ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יְהוָ֑ה יַשְּׁרוּ֙ בָּעֲרָבָ֔ה מְסִלָּ֖ה לֵאלֹהֵֽינוּ׃

controles.web: The voice of one who calls out,  “Prepare the way of Yahweh in the wilderness! Make a level highway in the desert for our God.
controles.kjv: The voice of him that crieth in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the Lord, make straight in the desert a highway for our God.
controles.livre: Voz do que clama no deserto: Preparai o caminho do SENHOR; endireitai na terra estéril vereda ao nosso Deus.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־גֶּיא֙ יִנָּשֵׂ֔א וְכָל־הַ֥ר וְגִבְעָ֖ה יִשְׁפָּ֑לוּ וְהָיָ֤ה הֶֽעָקֹב֙ לְמִישׁ֔וֹר וְהָרְכָסִ֖ים לְבִקְעָֽה׃

controles.web: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low. The uneven shall be made level, and the rough places a plain.
controles.kjv: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low: and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough places plain:
controles.livre: Todo vale será levantado, e todo monte e morro serão abaixados; e o torto se endireitará, e o terreno acidentado se tornará plano.

versos.hebraico: וְנִגְלָ֖ה כְּב֣וֹד יְהוָ֑ה וְרָא֤וּ כָל־בָּשָׂר֙ יַחְדָּ֔ו כִּ֛י פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֵּֽר׃ס

controles.web: Yahweh’s glory shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together; for the mouth of Yahweh has spoken it.”
controles.kjv: And the glory of the Lord shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see it together: for the mouth of the Lord hath spoken it.
controles.livre: E a glória do SENHOR se manifestará; e toda carne juntamente verá; pois assim falou a boca do SENHOR.

versos.hebraico: ק֚וֹל אֹמֵ֣ר קְרָ֔א וְאָמַ֖ר מָ֣ה אֶקְרָ֑א כָּל־הַבָּשָׂ֣ר חָצִ֔יר וְכָל־חַסְדּ֖וֹ כְּצִ֥יץ הַשָּׂדֶֽה׃

controles.web: The voice of one saying, “Cry!”  One said, “What shall I cry?” “All flesh is like grass, and all its glory is like the flower of the field.
controles.kjv: The voice said, Cry. And he said, What shall I cry? All flesh is grass, and all the goodliness thereof is as the flower of the field:
controles.livre: Uma voz: Clama!E ele disse: O que clamarei? Que toda carne é erva, e toda a sua bondade como as flores do campo.

versos.hebraico: יָבֵ֤שׁ חָצִיר֙ נָ֣בֵֽל צִ֔יץ כִּ֛י ר֥וּחַ יְהוָ֖ה נָ֣שְׁבָה בּ֑וֹ אָכֵ֥ן חָצִ֖יר הָעָֽם׃

controles.web: The grass withers, the flower fades, because Yahweh’s breath blows on it. Surely the people are like grass.
controles.kjv: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: because the spirit of the Lord bloweth upon it: surely the people is grass.
controles.livre: A erva se seca, as flores caem, porque o Espírito do SENHOR nelas sopra; verdadeiramente o povo é erva.

versos.hebraico: יָבֵ֥שׁ חָצִ֖יר נָ֣בֵֽל צִ֑יץ וּדְבַר־אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ יָק֥וּם לְעוֹלָֽם׃ס

controles.web: The grass withers, the flower fades; but the word of our God stands forever.”
controles.kjv: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand for ever.
controles.livre: A erva se seca, as flores caem; porém a palavra do nosso Deus continua firme para sempre.

versos.hebraico: עַ֣ל הַר־גָּבֹ֤הַ עֲלִי־לָךְ֙ מְבַשֶּׂ֣רֶת צִיּ֔וֹן הָרִ֤ימִי בַכֹּ֨חַ֙ קוֹלֵ֔ךְ מְבַשֶּׂ֖רֶת יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם הָרִ֨ימִי֙ אַל־תִּירָ֔אִי אִמְרִי֙ לְעָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה הִנֵּ֖ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

controles.web: You who tell good news to Zion, go up on a high mountain. You who tell good news to Jerusalem, lift up your voice with strength. Lift it up. Don’t be afraid. Say to the cities of Judah, “Behold, your God!”
controles.kjv: O Zion, that bringest good tidings, get thee up into the high mountain; O Jerusalem, that bringest good tidings, lift up thy voice with strength; lift it up, be not afraid; say unto the cities of Judah, Behold your God!
controles.livre: Ó Sião, que anuncias boas novas, sobe até um monte alto! Ó Jerusalém, que anuncias boas novas, levanta tua voz com força; levanta-a, não temas; dize as cidades de Judá: Eis aqui o vosso Deus!

versos.hebraico: הִנֵּ֨ה אֲדֹנָ֤י יְהוִה֙ בְּחָזָ֣ק יָב֔וֹא וּזְרֹע֖וֹ מֹ֣שְׁלָה ל֑וֹ הִנֵּ֤ה שְׂכָרוֹ֙ אִתּ֔וֹ וּפְעֻלָּת֖וֹ לְפָנָֽיו׃

controles.web: Behold, the Lord Yahweh will come as a mighty one, and his arm will rule for him. Behold, his reward is with him, and his recompense before him.
controles.kjv: Behold, the Lord God will come with strong hand, and his arm shall rule for him: behold, his reward is with him, and his work before him.
controles.livre: Eis que o Senhor DEUS virá com poder; e seu braço governará por ele; eis que sua retribuição virá com ele, e seu pagamento diante de si.

versos.hebraico: כְּרֹעֶה֙ עֶדְר֣וֹ יִרְעֶ֔ה בִּזְרֹעוֹ֙ יְקַבֵּ֣ץ טְלָאִ֔ים וּבְחֵיק֖וֹ יִשָּׂ֑א עָל֖וֹת יְנַהֵֽל׃ס

controles.web: He will feed his flock like a shepherd. He will gather the lambs in his arm, and carry them in his bosom. He will gently lead those who have their young.
controles.kjv: He shall feed his flock like a shepherd: he shall gather the lambs with his arm, and carry them in his bosom, and shall gently lead those that are with young.
controles.livre: Como pastor ele apascentará seu rebanho; em seus braços recolherá aos cordeirinhos, e os levará em seu colo; ele guiará mansamente as que tiveram filhotes.

versos.hebraico: מִֽי־מָדַ֨ד בְּשָׁעֳל֜וֹ מַ֗יִם וְשָׁמַ֨יִם֙ בַּזֶּ֣רֶת תִּכֵּ֔ן וְכָ֥ל בַּשָּׁלִ֖שׁ עֲפַ֣ר הָאָ֑רֶץ וְשָׁקַ֤ל בַּפֶּ֨לֶס֙ הָרִ֔ים וּגְבָע֖וֹת בְּמֹאזְנָֽיִם׃

controles.web: Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and marked off the sky with his span, and calculated the dust of the earth in a measure, and weighed the mountains in scales, and the hills in a balance?
controles.kjv: Who hath measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and meted out heaven with the span, and comprehended the dust of the earth in a measure, and weighed the mountains in scales, and the hills in a balance?
controles.livre: Quem mediu com seu punho as águas, e tomou a medida dos céus aos palmos? E quem recolheu numa caixa de medida o pó da terra, e pesou os montes com pesos, e os morros com balanças?

versos.hebraico: מִֽי־תִכֵּ֥ן אֶת־ר֖וּחַ יְהוָ֑ה וְאִ֥ישׁ עֲצָת֖וֹ יוֹדִיעֶֽנּוּ׃

controles.web: Who has directed the Spirit of Yahweh, or has taught him as his counselor?
controles.kjv: Who hath directed the Spirit of the Lord, or being his counsellor hath taught him?
controles.livre: Quem guiou o Espírito do SENHOR? E que conselheiro o ensinou?

versos.hebraico: אֶת־מִ֤י נוֹעָץ֙ וַיְבִינֵ֔הוּ וַֽיְלַמְּדֵ֖הוּ בְּאֹ֣רַח מִשְׁפָּ֑ט וַיְלַמְּדֵ֣הוּ דַ֔עַת וְדֶ֥רֶךְ תְּבוּנ֖וֹת יוֹדִיעֶֽנּוּ׃

controles.web: Who did he take counsel with, and who instructed him, and taught him in the path of justice, and taught him knowledge, and showed him the way of understanding?
controles.kjv: With whom took he counsel, and who instructed him, and taught him in the path of judgment, and taught him knowledge, and shewed to him the way of understanding?
controles.livre: Com quem ele tomou conselho? Quem lhe deu entendimento, e lhe ensinou o caminho do juízo, e lhe ensinou conhecimento, e lhe mostrou o caminho do entendimento?

versos.hebraico: הֵ֤ן גּוֹיִם֙ כְּמַ֣ר מִדְּלִ֔י וּכְשַׁ֥חַק מֹאזְנַ֖יִם נֶחְשָׁ֑בוּ הֵ֥ן אִיִּ֖ים כַּדַּ֥ק יִטּֽוֹל׃

controles.web: Behold, the nations are like a drop in a bucket, and are regarded as a speck of dust on a balance. Behold, he lifts up the islands like a very little thing.
controles.kjv: Behold, the nations are as a drop of a bucket, and are counted as the small dust of the balance: behold, he taketh up the isles as a very little thing.
controles.livre: Eis que as nações lhe são consideradas como uma gota de balde, e como o pó miúdo das balanças; eis que ele levanta as ilhas como poeira.

versos.hebraico: וּלְבָנ֕וֹן אֵ֥ין דֵּ֖י בָּעֵ֑ר וְחַיָּת֔וֹ אֵ֥ין דֵּ֖י עוֹלָֽה׃ס

controles.web: Lebanon is not sufficient to burn, nor its animals sufficient for a burnt offering.
controles.kjv: And Lebanon is not sufficient to burn, nor the beasts thereof sufficient for a burnt offering.
controles.livre: Nem todo o Líbano seria suficiente para o fogo, nem seus animais bastam para servirem de oferta de queima.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־הַגּוֹיִ֖ם כְּאַ֣יִן נֶגְדּ֑וֹ מֵאֶ֥פֶס וָתֹ֖הוּ נֶחְשְׁבוּ־לֽוֹ׃

controles.web: All the nations are like nothing before him. They are regarded by him as less than nothing, and vanity.
controles.kjv: All nations before him are as nothing; and they are counted to him less than nothing, and vanity.
controles.livre: Todas as nações são como nada perante ele; menos que nada e vazio ele as considera.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶל־מִ֖י תְּדַמְּי֣וּן אֵ֑ל וּמַה־דְּמ֖וּת תַּ֥עַרְכוּ לֽוֹ׃

controles.web: To whom then will you liken God? Or what likeness will you compare to him?
controles.kjv: To whom then will ye liken God? or what likeness will ye compare unto him?
controles.livre: A quem, pois, comparareis a Deus? Ou que semelhança atribuireis a ele?

versos.hebraico: הַפֶּ֨סֶל֙ נָסַ֣ךְ חָרָ֔שׁ וְצֹרֵ֖ף בַּזָּהָ֣ב יְרַקְּעֶ֑נּוּ וּרְתֻק֥וֹת כֶּ֖סֶף צוֹרֵֽף׃

controles.web: A workman has cast an image, and the goldsmith overlays it with gold, and casts silver chains for it.
controles.kjv: The workman melteth a graven image, and the goldsmith spreadeth it over with gold, and casteth silver chains.
controles.livre: O artífice funde a imagem, e o ourives a cobre de ouro, e cadeias de prata lhe funde.

versos.hebraico: הַֽמְסֻכָּ֣ן תְּרוּמָ֔ה עֵ֥ץ לֹֽא־יִרְקַ֖ב יִבְחָ֑ר חָרָ֤שׁ חָכָם֙ יְבַקֶּשׁ־ל֔וֹ לְהָכִ֥ין פֶּ֖סֶל לֹ֥א יִמּֽוֹט׃

controles.web: He who is too impoverished for such an offering chooses a tree that will not rot. He seeks a skillful workman to set up an engraved image for him that will not be moved.
controles.kjv: He that is so impoverished that he hath no oblation chooseth a tree that will not rot; he seeketh unto him a cunning workman to prepare a graven image, that shall not be moved.
controles.livre: O empobrecido, que não tem o que oferecer, escolhe madeira que não se estraga, e busca um artífice habilidoso, para preparar uma imagem que não se mova.

versos.hebraico: הֲל֤וֹא תֵֽדְעוּ֙ הֲל֣וֹא תִשְׁמָ֔עוּ הֲל֛וֹא הֻגַּ֥ד מֵרֹ֖אשׁ לָכֶ֑ם הֲלוֹא֙ הֲבִ֣ינֹתֶ֔ם מוֹסְד֖וֹת הָאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: Haven’t you known? Haven’t you heard, yet? Haven’t you been told from the beginning? Haven’t you understood from the foundations of the earth?
controles.kjv: Have ye not known? have ye not heard? hath it not been told you from the beginning? have ye not understood from the foundations of the earth?
controles.livre: Por acaso não sabeis? Por acaso não ouvis? Ou desde o princípio não vos disseram? Por acaso não tendes entendido desde os fundamentos da terra?

versos.hebraico: הַיֹּשֵׁב֙ עַל־ח֣וּג הָאָ֔רֶץ וְיֹשְׁבֶ֖יהָ כַּחֲגָבִ֑ים הַנּוֹטֶ֤ה כַדֹּק֙ שָׁמַ֔יִם וַיִּמְתָּחֵ֥ם כָּאֹ֖הֶל לָשָֽׁבֶת׃

controles.web: It is he who sits above the circle of the earth, and its inhabitants are like grasshoppers; who stretches out the heavens like a curtain, and spreads them out like a tent to dwell in;
controles.kjv: It is he that sitteth upon the circle of the earth, and the inhabitants thereof are as grasshoppers; that stretcheth out the heavens as a curtain, and spreadeth them out as a tent to dwell in:
controles.livre: Ele é o que está sentado sobre o globo da terra, cujos moradores são para ele como gafanhotos; ele é o que estende os céus como uma cortina, e os estica como uma tenda, para neles habitar.

versos.hebraico: הַנּוֹתֵ֥ן רוֹזְנִ֖ים לְאָ֑יִן שֹׁ֥פְטֵי אֶ֖רֶץ כַּתֹּ֥הוּ עָשָֽׂה׃

controles.web: who brings princes to nothing; who makes the judges of the earth like meaningless.
controles.kjv: That bringeth the princes to nothing; he maketh the judges of the earth as vanity.
controles.livre: Ele é o que torna os príncipes em nada, e faz juízes da terra serem como o vazio.

versos.hebraico: אַ֣ף בַּל־נִטָּ֗עוּ אַ֚ף בַּל־זֹרָ֔עוּ אַ֛ף בַּל־שֹׁרֵ֥שׁ בָּאָ֖רֶץ גִּזְעָ֑ם וְגַם־נָשַׁ֤ף בָּהֶם֙ וַיִּבָ֔שׁוּ וּסְעָרָ֖ה כַּקַּ֥שׁ תִּשָּׂאֵֽם׃ס

controles.web: They are planted scarcely. They are sown scarcely. Their stock has scarcely taken root in the ground. He merely blows on them, and they wither, and the whirlwind takes them away as stubble.
controles.kjv: Yea, they shall not be planted; yea, they shall not be sown: yea, their stock shall not take root in the earth: and he shall also blow upon them, and they shall wither, and the whirlwind shall take them away as stubble.
controles.livre: Mal foram plantados, mal foram semeados, mal seu caule forma raízes na terra; e logo ele sopra neles, e se secam, e um vento forte os leva como palha fina.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶל־מִ֥י תְדַמְּי֖וּנִי וְאֶשְׁוֶ֑ה יֹאמַ֖ר קָדֽוֹשׁ׃

controles.web: “To whom then will you liken me? Who is my equal?” says the Holy One.
controles.kjv: To whom then will ye liken me, or shall I be equal? saith the Holy One.
controles.livre: A quem, pois, me comparareis, que eu lhe seja semelhante?,diz o Santo.

versos.hebraico: שְׂאוּ־מָר֨וֹם עֵינֵיכֶ֤ם וּרְאוּ֙ מִי־בָרָ֣א אֵ֔לֶּה הַמּוֹצִ֥יא בְמִסְפָּ֖ר צְבָאָ֑ם לְכֻלָּם֙ בְּשֵׁ֣ם יִקְרָ֔א מֵרֹ֤ב אוֹנִים֙ וְאַמִּ֣יץ כֹּ֔חַ אִ֖ישׁ לֹ֥א נֶעְדָּֽר׃ס

controles.web: Lift up your eyes on high, and see who has created these, who brings out their army by number. He calls them all by name. by the greatness of his might, and because he is strong in power, Not one is lacking.
controles.kjv: Lift up your eyes on high, and behold who hath created these things, that bringeth out their host by number: he calleth them all by names by the greatness of his might, for that he is strong in power; not one faileth.
controles.livre: Levantai vossos olhos ao alto, e vede quem criou estas coisas, que faz sair numerado seu exército; e chama a todos eles pelos nomes, pela grandeza de suas forças, e por ser forte em poder, nenhuma delas faltará.

versos.hebraico: לָ֤מָּה תֹאמַר֙ יַֽעֲקֹ֔ב וּתְדַבֵּ֖ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל נִסְתְּרָ֤ה דַרְכִּי֙ מֵֽיְהוָ֔ה וּמֵאֱלֹהַ֖י מִשְׁפָּטִ֥י יַעֲבֽוֹר׃

controles.web: Why do you say, Jacob, and speak, Israel, “My way is hidden from Yahweh, and the justice due me is disregarded by my God?”
controles.kjv: Why sayest thou, O Jacob, and speakest, O Israel, My way is hid from the Lord, and my judgment is passed over from my God?
controles.livre: Por que dizes, ó Jacó, e falas, ó Israel: Meu caminho está escondido do SENHOR, e meu juízo passa longe de meu Deus?

versos.hebraico: הֲל֨וֹא יָדַ֜עְתָּ אִם־לֹ֣א שָׁמַ֗עְתָּ אֱלֹהֵ֨י עוֹלָ֤ם׀ יְהוָה֙ בּוֹרֵא֙ קְצ֣וֹת הָאָ֔רֶץ לֹ֥א יִיעַ֖ף וְלֹ֣א יִיגָ֑ע אֵ֥ין חֵ֖קֶר לִתְבוּנָתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Haven’t you known? Haven’t you heard? The everlasting God, Yahweh, The Creator of the ends of the earth, doesn’t faint. He isn’t weary. His understanding is unsearchable.
controles.kjv: Hast thou not known? hast thou not heard, that the everlasting God, the Lord, the Creator of the ends of the earth, fainteth not, neither is weary? there is no searching of his understanding.
controles.livre: Por acaso não sabes, nem ouviste, que o eterno Deus, o SENHOR, o criador dos confins da terra, não se cansa, nem se fatiga, e que seu entendimento é incompreensível?

versos.hebraico: נֹתֵ֥ן לַיָּעֵ֖ף כֹּ֑חַ וּלְאֵ֥ין אוֹנִ֖ים עָצְמָ֥ה יַרְבֶּֽה׃

controles.web: He gives power to the weak. He increases the strength of him who has no might.
controles.kjv: He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength.
controles.livre: Ele dá força ao cansado, e multiplica as forças daquele que não tem vigor.

versos.hebraico: וְיִֽעֲפ֥וּ נְעָרִ֖ים וְיִגָ֑עוּ וּבַחוּרִ֖ים כָּשׁ֥וֹל יִכָּשֵֽׁלוּ׃

controles.web: Even the youths faint and get weary, and the young men utterly fall;
controles.kjv: Even the youths shall faint and be weary, and the young men shall utterly fall:
controles.livre: Até os jovens se cansam e se fatigam; e os rapazes caem;

versos.hebraico: וְקוֹיֵ֤ יְהוָה֙ יַחֲלִ֣יפוּ כֹ֔חַ יַעֲל֥וּ אֵ֖בֶר כַּנְּשָׁרִ֑ים יָר֨וּצוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א יִיגָ֔עוּ יֵלְכ֖וּ וְלֹ֥א יִיעָֽפוּ׃פ

controles.web: But those who wait for Yahweh will renew their strength. They will mount up with wings like eagles. They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint.
controles.kjv: But they that wait upon the Lord shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.
controles.livre: Mas os que confiam no SENHOR renovarão as forças, subirão com asas como águias; correrão, e não se cansarão; caminharão, e não se fatigarão.
